about: Frozen sessions of the symmetric Knife regression rows (AD-SYM-03 §10.8, slice 6b). Extracted once from experiments/topology/symmetry_knife_probe.py by experiments/topology/extract_symmetric_knife_sessions.py; `expect` pins what the probe's K-C+clip produced. Paths are the full session path (points in space included); ids are those of the session-start mesh (examples/meshes assets with the plane x = 0 and the derived seam, or the synthetic grids of tests/test_symmetric_knife.py).
